modeHelp.motion: Motion mode: each frame is normalized by its own noise (noise units per frame). It is useful to see displacements, but brightness is NOT comparable between frames.
modeHelp.brightness: Brightness mode: all frames share the same linear scale, so brightness is comparable between epochs.

fieldHelp.flagged: Fraction of pixels flagged by the archive as unreliable (cosmic rays, saturation, dead pixels). The higher it is, the less reliable the frame.
fieldHelp.coverage: Fraction of the cutout covered by real data from this exposure. If it is low, part of the image is empty.
fieldHelp.collection: IRSA archive collection the exposure comes from.
fieldHelp.wavelength: Effective wavelength at the center of the cutout. SPHEREx observes with a variable filter: each exposure covers a different range.
fieldHelp.detector: SPHEREx detector that recorded the frame. All frames in a sequence share a detector so they are comparable.

cache.notice: {notice}. IRSA did not respond; this is the latest real result for the same request, not a recent one.

share.failed: Could not copy. Copy this link by hand: {url}

export.failed: The export failed. Please try again.
export.webmDone: WebM video downloaded with {count, plural, one {# segment} other {# segments}}, one per frame.
export.pngFallback: This browser cannot record WebM: {count, plural, one {# PNG image was} other {# PNG images were}} downloaded, one per frame, each with date, detector and attribution. If any are missing, allow multiple downloads.

sequencePlayer.playerLabel: Sequence player. Space plays or pauses; arrows change the frame.
sequencePlayer.loadFailed: No frame of the sequence could be loaded. Try again in a few seconds.

reference.caption: Another mission, another resolution. {label} · band {band} · epoch {epoch}

display.help: Only changes how the image looks on your screen and applies equally to every frame, so comparisons between frames stay valid. Downloads use the original image.

probe.hint: Click the image to mark a point and see its coordinates.
probe.label: Marked point (RA, Dec J2000)
probe.precision: Accurate to about 3″: each SPHEREx pixel is 6.15″ wide. The mark stays on the same point of the sky in every frame.

track.known: The trajectory uses the known proper motion{detail}. Blue circle: predicted position at the first visit; orange cross: at the last; white ring: predicted position in this frame (radius = uncertainty).
track.fixed: No known proper motion: the target is marked at a fixed position.

sequencePlayer.framesFailed: {failed} of {total} frames could not be loaded; those steps may appear empty.
sequencePlayer.singleEpoch: The archive has only one epoch covering this field. There is no sequence to play: the only available image is shown.

controls.reducedMotion: Your system asks for reduced motion: the sequence does not play on its own.

meta.label: Frame metadata
meta.flaggedWarning: Warning: {percent} of the pixels in this frame are flagged (threshold {threshold}). Interpret any change with caution.

grid.title: Common grid
grid.framesUsedLimited: {used} frames used out of {available} available (the requested frame limit applies).
grid.notMeasurement: These images are a sequence view, not a motion measurement.

difference.alt: Difference image: frame {number} minus reference frame {reference}
difference.legend: Frame shown minus frame A ({reference}). Orange: brighter than in A (something arrived or brightened). Blue: fainter than in A (something left or dimmed). Black: no change. Differences use the displayed scale and saturate at its limits. Changes within 3× the noise of the difference are shown as black.
difference.failed: The difference image could not be computed (the frames could not be read).

beforeAfter.motionSentence: Moved {arcsec}″ to the {direction} between {from} and {to}, as the catalogue predicts.
beforeAfter.motionNote: This is the catalogued proper motion used by the overlaid trajectory; it is not a measurement made on these images.
beforeAfter.reducedMotion: Your system asks for reduced motion: automatic blinking is off; use the curtain.
beforeAfter.skippedEnds: The extreme epochs with good coverage (at least 80 % of the cutout) are compared, after aligning the images.
beforeAfter.ends: First and last epoch of the sequence, after aligning the images.
beforeAfter.ring: The white circle marks where the target should be in each epoch.
beforeAfter.faint: This target is too faint to see by eye in each frame: the circle marks where it should be. To check it, use visit stacking (Planet X) in the advanced options.

cutoutComparison.cutoutFailed: The cutout could not be prepared
cutoutComparison.someFailed: {failed} of {total} cutouts failed. Try again; no data was invented.
cutoutComparison.title: Manual A/B comparison
cutoutComparison.noSelection: Select observations in the Living sky to prepare cutouts and compare them.
cutoutComparison.overlayNote: Visual overlay without alignment: it is not a measurement.
cutoutComparison.diffLegend: Difference: red = brighter in A, blue = brighter in B (after aligning and matching the background).
cutoutComparison.runPrompt: Run the differential analysis to measure real changes.
cutoutComparison.noChanges: No significant changes were detected between the two images.
cutoutComparison.possibleChanges: {count, plural, one {# possible change is marked} other {# possible changes are marked}}. Each mark is a candidate to validate.

heatmap.label: Significance map by velocity. Use the arrows to choose a velocity.
heatmap.title: Uncorrected significance by east and north velocity
heatmap.selected: Chosen velocity: east {east} ″/yr, north {north} ″/yr; uncorrected significance {value}.
heatmap.bestBox: White box: the best velocity of the search.

targeted.title: Check with the known motion of the target
targeted.found: There is signal at the position predicted by its proper motion: it is compatible with the object, but requires verification.
targeted.notFound: There is no significant signal at the position predicted by its proper motion.
targeted.pValue: Probability that chance matches that peak (p)
targeted.stackAlt: Image stacked following the proper motion of the target

shiftStack.title: Planet X mode: stacking search
shiftStack.intro: Shifts and adds the exposures, trying many velocities on the sky. A faint moving source appears as a peak at its velocity. It is a search with many trials: the corrected significance accounts for that effect.
shiftStack.cancelled: You stopped waiting for this search.
shiftStack.notRun: Search not run: there are {visits} visits and at least 3 are needed.
shiftStack.detected: Signal compatible with a moving object, requires verification.
shiftStack.notDetected: No significant signal after correcting for multiple search.
shiftStack.stackAlt: Image stacked at the best velocity of the search
shiftStack.stackCaption: Image stacked at the best velocity.
